request.raw_text: Multiply amount of cylindrical feature to 4. Imagine this is a system of plant pots, so you need to add stability to that afterwards by adding another legs or ribs on the sides.

aim.primary_aim: Produce a plant-pot system containing four cylindrical features and side support geometry that improves stability.

functional_design_intentions.name: Improve stability
functional_design_intentions.description: The added side legs or ribs should stabilize the plant-pot system.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: stabilizing legs or ribs on the sides of the plant-pot system

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing form and dimensions of each cylindrical feature except for the requested change in quantity.
Preserve non-targeted geometry under a minimum-change rule while accommodating the four cylindrical features and side supports.

geometry.description: The final model contains four cylindrical features.
The final model contains added legs or ribs that act as side supports.

functions.name: Stabilization
functions.description: The side legs or ribs provide additional stability to the system of plant pots.

behaviors.name: Resistance to instability
behaviors.description: The side supports increase resistance to tipping or lateral instability.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that the final model contains exactly four cylindrical features.
Verify that stabilizing leg or rib geometry exists on the sides of the plant-pot system.
Verify that the added side supports contribute stability to the plant-pot system.
Verify that the added side supports improve resistance to tipping or lateral instability.
Verify that non-targeted geometry and the form and dimensions of the individual cylindrical features are preserved except where accommodation of the requested supports requires local change.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not identify the existing cylindrical feature by a model feature or section ID.
candidate_interpretations: The model has one identifiable cylindrical feature whose final instance count should be four.
The model has multiple cylindrical features and the intended cylindrical feature must be selected from context.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact support type, quantity, dimensions, and side placement are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Add discrete legs on the sides.
Add reinforcing ribs on the sides.
Use a combination of side legs and ribs.

unresolved_requirements.description: The wording most strongly indicates a final total of four cylindrical features, but it could be interpreted as multiplying the existing quantity by four.
candidate_interpretations: Set the total cylindrical-feature quantity to four.
Increase the current cylindrical-feature quantity by a factor of four.

unresolved_requirements.description: No quantitative stability requirement or loading condition is provided.
candidate_interpretations: Improve qualitative resistance to lateral movement.
Provide broader structural support without a specified load threshold.
